description.summary: Unidentified aerial phenomena (UAPs/UFOs) and alleged encounters with non-human intelligences. Includes sightings of unexplained craft and reported contact with extraterrestrial or interdimensional beings.
description.full: The UFO/UAP phenomenon encompasses sightings of unidentified aerial objects and alleged encounters with non-human intelligences that have been reported throughout human history but gained prominence in the modern era beginning with the 1947 Kenneth Arnold sighting. The phenomenon includes simple sightings (Close Encounters of the First Kind), physical evidence cases (Second Kind), contact with occupants (Third Kind), abductions (Fourth Kind), and communication (Fifth Kind). In 2020, the US government officially acknowledged UAPs as a national security concern, releasing footage and establishing investigative offices. The phenomenon remains one of the most documented yet unexplained aspects of human experience, with thousands of credible witnesses including military personnel, pilots, and astronauts.

history.modern_era: The modern UFO era began in 1947 and continues today with unprecedented government acknowledgment. The US government has established official UAP investigation offices (AARO), held congressional hearings, and released previously classified footage. Multiple whistleblowers have come forward claiming knowledge of crash retrieval and reverse engineering programs. The phenomenon has transitioned from fringe topic to serious national security discussion.

notable.name: Kenneth Arnold Sighting
notable.description: Private pilot Kenneth Arnold reported seeing nine crescent-shaped objects flying in formation near Mount Rainier at estimated 1,200+ mph. His description of their movement 'like a saucer skipping across water' led newspapers to coin the term 'flying saucer.' This is considered the beginning of the modern UFO era.

notable.name: Roswell Incident
notable.description: Debris field discovered on ranch; Army initially announced recovery of 'flying disc' before retracting to 'weather balloon.' Witnesses later claimed bodies were recovered. Decades of investigation and controversy followed. Air Force attributed to Project Mogul balloon in 1994.

credibility.notes: Most famous and controversial UFO case

notable.name: USS Nimitz Tic-Tac Encounter

location.description: Pacific Ocean, off San Diego coast

notable.description: Navy F/A-18 pilots from USS Nimitz carrier group encountered a white, tic-tac shaped object that exhibited extraordinary flight characteristics including instantaneous acceleration and trans-medium travel. Radar tracked objects descending from 80,000 feet to sea level in seconds. Commander David Fravor and Lt. Cmdr. Alex Dietrich were primary pilot witnesses. FLIR footage recorded.

credibility.notes: Key case in modern disclosure; released by Pentagon

notable.name: Rendlesham Forest Incident
notable.description: Over several nights, US Air Force personnel at RAF Woodbridge witnessed and investigated a landed craft in Rendlesham Forest. Deputy Base Commander Lt. Col. Charles Halt documented the incident on audio tape while investigating. Witnesses reported touching the craft and seeing hieroglyphic-like markings.
